Ffion Goldgrind is a dead Dwarf whose corpse is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.
“
Shameful to be killed by your own son. That honour should fall to a daughter.
„
— Minthara, on speaking to Ffion's corpse

Overview

A dominatrix of renown at Sharess' Caress, Ffion went missing and the party is tasked with finding her in ⁠Find the 'Stern Librarian' Ffion.

Interactions

Ffion's corpse is hidden underneath the bed in the secret room of Fraygo's Flophouse's attic. It can be found after inspecting the blood on the ground and passing a  DC 10 Investigation Check, or destroying the bed.

Reading the pieces of literature found throughout the room reveals that her death is closely related to the ⁠Open Hand Temple Murders and the ⁠spree of murders in Baldur's Gate. She was murdered by her own son  Dolor, a  Cultist of Bhaal who aims to become an Unholy Assassin.

Loot

  • Ffion's Key - Unlocks her belongings chest downstairs in the Flophouse

  • What is this place?

      Landlord...contraband storage...

    • Ffion Goldgrind
      Murdered...by my son...
  • What were you doing when you died?

      Seeking...answers...

    • Ffion Goldgrind

    • Ffion Goldgrind

    • Ffion Goldgrind

  • Who has your son killed?
    • Ffion Goldgrind
      Me...and...and...

    • Ffion Goldgrind
      Ilmater temple...Didn't see...exactly who...
  • Where can I find your son?
    • Narrator
      *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*

    • Ffion Goldgrind
      Dwarf...Like me...Dresses in...red...
  • Did your son kill you?
    • Ffion Goldgrind
      Yes...grinned...whole time...
